```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
```

```{r helper, include=FALSE}
# make_preds_table()
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Builds a LaTeX summary table of real-data exceedance probability predictions
# for a single fire weather station, across all three prediction boxes (b1, b2,
# b3). For each box / likelihood / angular density / BMA method combination, it
# reports the posterior median and 95% credible interval (computed across all
# posterior iterations), scaled by 10^5.
#
# Reads the all-iteration prediction files produced by
# data_analyses/imp_samp_real_data_all_iter.R:
#   real_data_preds/{location}_b{1,2,3}_all_iter.qs
#
# Args:
#   location      - "friendmtn" or "redstone"
#   censored_only - logical. If TRUE, filter to censored-likelihood results only
#                   and drop the likelihood column (the format used for the
#                   defense presentation). If FALSE (default), show both
#                   truncated and censored results (the format used in the
#                   manuscript).
#
# Returns: a kableExtra LaTeX table object.
make_preds_table <- function(location, censored_only = FALSE) {
  # Load and stack the three prediction boxes
  all_boxes <- map_dfr(c("b1", "b2", "b3"), function(b) {
    qread(sprintf("../real_data_preds/%s_%s_all_iter.qs", location, b)) |>
      mutate(box = b)
  })

  # For the censored-only (presentation) format, drop truncated results
  if (censored_only) {
    all_boxes <- all_boxes |> filter(!grepl("trunc", ang_dens))
  }

  # Summarise to posterior median and 95% CI per box/method/angular density,
  # scaled by 10^5 and formatted to 3 significant figures
  summary_tbl <- all_boxes |>
    group_by(ang_dens, method, box) |>
    summarize(lb  = quantile(preds, 0.025),
              ub  = quantile(preds, 0.975),
              med = median(preds),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(mult_factor = 10^5,
           ci95 = sprintf("(%s, %s)",
                          formatC(signif(lb * mult_factor, 3), format = "fg", digits = 3, flag = "#"),
                          formatC(signif(ub * mult_factor, 3), format = "fg", digits = 3, flag = "#")),
           med   = formatC(signif(med * mult_factor, 3), format = "fg", digits = 3, flag = "#"),
           medci = sprintf("%s %s", med, ci95)) |>
    select(box, ang_dens, method, medci) |>
    rename(angdens = ang_dens) |>
    arrange(box) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = medci) |>
    separate_wider_delim(angdens, names = c("likelihood", "dens"), delim = ", ")

  if (censored_only) {
    # Censored-only format: drop the (now constant) likelihood column,
    # 5-column table collapsing rows on the dens column only
    summary_tbl |>
      select(-likelihood) |>
      kbl(format = "latex", align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
          booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) |>
      collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "middle")
  } else {
    # Manuscript format: keep both likelihoods, 6-column table collapsing
    # rows on both the likelihood and dens columns
    summary_tbl |>
      kbl(format = "latex", align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
          booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) |>
      collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, latex_hline = "major", valign = "middle")
  }
}
```

## Friend Mountain (manuscript: both likelihoods)

```{r friendmtn, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_preds_table("friendmtn", censored_only = FALSE)
```

## Redstone (manuscript: both likelihoods)

```{r redstone, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_preds_table("redstone", censored_only = FALSE)
```
